proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10648 raśmi “rope” gives Prakrit rassi/rāsi and Punjabi rassī, explicitly transmitted to Hindi and several other IA languages. Under the user’s policy this family is linked while the survey lect’s immediate transmission remains unresolved; no uninterrupted inheritance is asserted. RNS uncertainty concerns locality mapping only; the source audit establishes the lexical reading.
